notes.title: Minor Patch:
notes.notes:
Screech 0.9.3 – Patch Notes

Major Updates:

New UI Improvements:

Enhanced navigation for objectives and better understanding of time travel mechanics, including time remaining in the past.
Save Game & Level Transition: Rebuilt save game structure and level transitions for improved stability and performance.


Gameplay Enhancements:


 Smooth Crouching:Crouching is now smoother but remains toggle-only. Sprinting is now possible while crouched.
 Tool Switching: Added the ability to swap between tools using the 1, 2, and 3 keys.
 Temporal Threads Update: Temporal Threads (visible in the glass monocle to guide players to sub-objectives) are now more vibrant and captivating.


UI & Accessibility:


 Subtitles: added for in-game voice lines.
 Extra instructions: added to certain tutorials for improved clarity.
 Post-Process Fix: Screen effects now fit appropriately.


Map & Navigation Adjustments:


 Lights added to vents in the Study level for better visibility.
 Removed unnecessary objectives in the Maze for a more streamlined experience.


Quality of Life Improvements:


 Cutscenes are now skippable in certain parts of the game.

Bug Fixes:


 Fixed a bug that caused the player to fail to spawn
 Resolved an issue where the intro/tutorial would spawn every time the player entered the Library Hub.
 Fixed a bug that caused the auto-save to fail when enabled

Performance Enhancements:


 Optimization improvements for a smoother gameplay experience.(Especially the Maze)

notes.title: Screech 0.9.1 – Day 1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Major Fixes:
Fixed an issue that allowed players to complete the game at the start.

Gameplay Improvements:
Added a transparent item indicator to show where shards need to be moved.
Introduced a monocle UI notifier when near temporal threads, prompting players to use the monocle.
Added instructions on how to swap between tools in both the Time Piece and Ghost Tool tutorials.

UI & Accessibility:
Minor fixes to Objective Location UI for better clarity.
Updated credits.

Map & Navigation Tweaks:
Adjusted map layout to improve accessibility and make reaching objectives easier.
